gaps.explanation: Statement lines come from the modified-cash Statement of Activities pp2-3: charges for services 1,788,076 (Electric 1,090,184, Water 304,110, Sewer 295,900, Garbage 97,882) + investment income 98 + miscellaneous income 1,089 = 1,789,263. Detail comes from the proprietary funds statement of revenues, expenses and changes in net position p7 (accrual-type figures): total operating revenues 1,797,111 (charges 1,796,022: Electric 1,094,933, Water 304,070, Sewer 297,496, Non-Major 99,523; misc 1,089) + investment income 98 = 1,797,209. The printed charges differ by 7,946 (1,796,022 - 1,788,076); every p7 line is in detail, nothing missing or duplicated.

Statement: Statement of Activities p2 business-type expenditures 1,853,036 (modified cash: Electric 887,312, Water 303,141, Sewer 194,724, Garbage 74,701, Debt Service Principal 355,000, Interest and Fees 38,158). The p7 statement shows depreciation instead of bond principal (355,000, p8 cash flows) and capital purchases (196,984, p8), and interest 30,889 vs 38,158, so the two printed totals really differ (370,791).
